How to use

Spread the puzzle pieces on a flat surface and begin assembling by connecting edge pieces to form the border. Work on filling in the interior by matching colors and patterns as shown in the image. Take breaks as needed to avoid fatigue and maintain focus. Once completed, the puzzle can be glued and framed for display. Handle pieces gently to avoid bending or damage.

Care instructions

Store puzzle pieces in a dry, cool place away from direct sunlight to prevent fading and warping. Keep pieces in a secure container or bag when not in use to avoid loss. Clean completed puzzles with a dry, soft cloth if dust accumulates. Avoid exposure to moisture and extreme temperatures to maintain puzzle quality.
